newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends up nine cents, tracks London's rise.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends up nine cents, tracks London's rise.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended up nine cents at 14.50 ringgit ($5.83) a kg, helped by a firmer London Metal Exchange (LME) close on Friday, traders said.
A larger offering, however, capped the rise, they said.
"Producers are back from the holidays but there's also strong buying interest," said one trader.
Turnover was 103 tonnes, up from 53 on Friday. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia.
The local price premium over LME narrowed further to $15 a tonne against $20 previously.
